title: Quantum-Informed Regularized Poisson Learning for Graph-Based Semi-Supervised Classification
abstract: arXiv:2611.27609v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce IPQSSL, a quantum-informed regularized Poisson framework for graph-based semi-supervised classification under scarce labels. Local graph feature contexts are QR factorized, lifted to unitary encodings, and processed by a shared variational circuit whose measurements yield node wise diagonal weights that stabilize a symmetrized Poisson system. We establish positive definiteness of the symmetrized, regularized operator under explicit spectral conditions and derive a Hermitian, block encoding compatible formulation that separates the classical NISQ oriented implementation from a future fault-tolerant pathway. Across seven benchmarks spanning tabular data and a citation network, the effect of regularization is dataset- and budget-dependent: IPQSSL improves over the Poisson baselines on Iris and Wine at all but the single-label budget, reaching 0.946 accuracy on Iris at ten labels per class and at every budget on German Credit, w

translated_title: 量子启发的正则化泊松学习用于基于图的半监督分类
translated_abstract: 我们提出了IPQSSL，一种量子启发的正则化泊松框架，用于标签稀缺情况下的基于图的半监督分类。局部图特征上下文经过QR分解，提升为酉编码，并由一个共享的变分量子线路处理，其测量结果产生逐节点的对角权重，用以稳定对称化的泊松系统。我们在显式谱条件下建立了对称化正则化算子的正定性，并推导出一种厄米特的、与块编码兼容的公式形式，从而将面向经典NISQ设备的实现与未来的容错计算路径分离开来。在涵盖表格数据和一个引文网络的七个基准测试中，正则化的效果依赖于数据集和标签预算：IPQSSL在除单标签预算外的所有预算下，在Iris和Wine数据集上均超越了泊松基线方法，在Iris数据集上每类十个标签时达到0.946的准确率，并在German Credit数据集的所有预算下均有提升……
tldr: 提出了量子启发的正则化泊松学习框架IPQSSL，利用共享变分量子线路产生节点对角权重以稳定对称化泊松系统，在标签稀缺的图半监督分类任务中取得了优于泊松基线的效果。
en_tdlr: We propose IPQSSL, a quantum-informed regularized Poisson learning framework that leverages a shared variational circuit to produce node-wise diagonal weights stabilizing a symmetrized Poisson system, achieving superior performance over Poisson baselines in graph-based semi-supervised classification with scarce labels.
